country_profiles.name: Netherlands
country_profiles.full_funding_strategy: Salaried PhD employee vacancies; prioritize AcademicTransfer, WUR and TU Delft.
country_profiles.decision_note: Excellent English and research/industry balance; housing pressure and permit type matter for long-term residence.

country_profiles.name: Australia
country_profiles.full_funding_strategy: Only tuition-offset + living-stipend routes or explicitly funded project scholarships.
country_profiles.decision_note: Excellent English-language career environment and direct thematic fit for Australian SAF research; PR remains points/policy dependent.

country_profiles.name: Canada
country_profiles.full_funding_strategy: Only guaranteed/minimum funding packages or full scholarship/RA funding routes.
country_profiles.decision_note: Strong immigration structure and English-language market; funding and housing conditions vary significantly by university and city.

country_profiles.name: Germany
country_profiles.full_funding_strategy: Prioritize salaried doctoral researcher jobs (TV-L/TVöD) and funded doctoral vacancies.
country_profiles.decision_note: Largest post-PhD industrial market in the target set; German language materially improves long-term career options.

country_profiles.name: Sweden
country_profiles.full_funding_strategy: Prioritize employed doctoral-student vacancies with salary.
country_profiles.decision_note: Strong quality of life and employed-PhD model; smaller specialist labour market than Germany, Australia or Canada.
